reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is user input from request.getParameter() placed in a data-* attribute (data-name). Data attributes are treated as opaque string storage by browsers and do not execute scripts regardless of content. The quote replacement (" → ") further neutralizes basic injection attempts. This is a structural false positive because the sink context (data attribute) is inherently safe for XSS.

evidence.note: User input from request.getParameter() flows through replace() and into data-name attribute which does not execute scripts
